subject.title: fix(oc-path): bound config file reads with size cap

question: Should the 16 MiB cap become the supported input limit for all oc-path formats and for `set --diff`, rather than only matching the existing JSONC parser boundary?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound and has live proof, but the cap deliberately changes acceptance behavior for formats whose prior size contract is not established by the supplied evidence.

options.title: Confirm universal cap
options.body: Accept 16 MiB as the documented operational limit for every oc-path file read and merge with focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Narrow the boundary
options.body: Limit the new guard to paths with an established parser boundary or define explicit per-format limits before merge.

recommendation.title: Confirm universal cap
recommendation.body: Accept 16 MiB as the documented operational limit for every oc-path file read and merge with focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest current implementation context, though a current-main oc-path owner should make the compatibility decision.
